# technitium_app_config (Resource)

Manages the config of an installed DNS app. The format is the app's own, usually JSON. Destroying the resource leaves the config as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_app_config" "split_horizon" {
  name = technitium_app.split_horizon.name
  config = jsonencode({
    networks = {
      lan = ["192.168.0.0/16"]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) The app's config as JSON, for example from `jsonencode(...)`. Differences in spacing and key order alone are not changes.
- `name` (String) The name of the installed app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_app_config.split_horizon "Split Horizon"
```
